name: toc-engine
title: ToC geometry engine
description: Framework-free table-of-contents engine: per-frame geometry snapshot computes IoM weights (intersection area / min(block, viewport) — saturates to 100% in both directions) and the line pick (the viewport-top line resolves to the region containing it; margins resolve DOWNWARD to the next block; mobile line sits at the sticky bar bottom + 2em).
docs: Observe regions with data-region on leaf heading-to-heading blocks and data-family on parent section extents. The engine calls onUpdate(weights: Map<id, 0..1>, pick: id | null) on scroll/resize (rAF-throttled).
